Table.Name: Command
Table.Command:
DO BEGIN DECLARE fromDate DATETIME = {?$[BOY_AB_FROMDATE]}; DECLARE toDate DATETIME = {?$[BOY_AB_TODATE]}; DECLARE fromDateDue DATETIME = {?$[BOY_AB_DUE_FROMDATE]}; DECLARE toDateDue DATETIME = {?$[BOY_AB_DUE_TODATE]}; DECLARE fromDateDoc DATETIME = {?$[BOY_AB_DOC_FROMDATE]}; DECLARE toDateDoc DATETIME = {?$[BOY_AB_DOC_TODATE]}; DECLARE cardCode NVARCHAR(15) = '{?CardCode}'; DECLARE branch INTEGER = {?$[BOY_AB_BRANCH]}; IF ('{?$[BOY_AB_INCLUDE_RT]}' = 'N') THEN ( SELECT MAX(T0."ShortName") AS "ShortName", T0."TransId" AS "TransId", MAX(T0."TransType") AS "TransType", MAX(T0."BaseRef") AS "BaseRef", MAX(T0."Ref1") AS "Ref1", MAX(T0."Ref2") AS "Ref2", MAX(T0."RefDate") AS "RefDate", MAX(T0."DueDate") AS "DueDate", MAX(T0."TaxDate") AS "TaxDate", 0 AS "Debit", IFNULL(MAX(T0."BalDueCred"),0) + IFNULL(SUM(T1."ReconSum"),0) AS "Credit", 0 AS "FcDebit", IFNULL(MAX(T0."BalFcCred"),0) + IFNULL(SUM(T1."ReconSumFC"),0) AS "FcCredit", MAX(T0."LineMemo") AS "LineMemo", MAX(T0."FCCurrency") AS "FCCurrency" FROM "JDT1" T0 INNER JOIN "ITR1" T1 ON T1."TransId" = T0."TransId" AND T1."TransRowId" = T0."Line_ID" INNER JOIN "OITR" T2 ON T2."ReconNum" = T1."ReconNum" INNER JOIN "OCRD" T4 ON T4."CardCode" = T0."ShortName" WHERE 1 = 1 AND CASE WHEN branch = -1 THEN -1 ELSE T0."BPLId" END = branch AND T0."RefDate" BETWEEN fromDate AND toDate AND T0."DueDate" BETWEEN fromDateDue AND toDateDue AND T0."TaxDate" BETWEEN fromDateDoc AND toDateDoc AND T4."CardCode" = cardCode AND T2."ReconDate" > toDate AND T1."IsCredit" = 'C' GROUP BY T0."TransId", T0."Line_ID", T0."BPLName" HAVING MAX(T0."BalFcCred") <> -SUM(T1."ReconSumFC") OR MAX(T0."BalDueCred") <> -SUM(T1."ReconSum")
UNION ALL SELECT MAX(T0."ShortName"), T0."TransId", MAX(T0."TransType"), MAX(T0."BaseRef"), MAX(T0."Ref1") AS "Ref1", MAX(T0."Ref2") AS "Ref2", MAX(T0."RefDate"), MAX(T0."DueDate"), MAX(T0."TaxDate"), IFNULL(MAX(T0."BalDueDeb"),0) + IFNULL(SUM(T1."ReconSum"),0), 0, IFNULL(MAX(T0."BalFcDeb"),0) + IFNULL(SUM(T1."ReconSumFC"),0), 0, MAX(T0."LineMemo"), MAX(T0."FCCurrency") FROM "JDT1" T0 INNER JOIN "ITR1" T1 ON T1."TransId" = T0."TransId" AND T1."TransRowId" = T0."Line_ID" INNER JOIN "OITR" T2 ON T2."ReconNum" = T1."ReconNum" INNER JOIN "OCRD" T4 ON T4."CardCode" = T0."ShortName" WHERE 1 = 1 AND CASE WHEN branch = -1 THEN -1 ELSE T0."BPLId" END = branch AND T0."RefDate" BETWEEN fromDate AND toDate AND T0."DueDate" BETWEEN fromDateDue AND toDateDue AND T0."TaxDate" BETWEEN fromDateDoc AND toDateDoc AND T4."CardCode" = CardCode AND T2."ReconDate" > toDate AND T1."IsCredit" = 'D' GROUP BY T0."TransId", T0."Line_ID", T0."BPLName" HAVING MAX(T0."BalFcDeb") <> -SUM(T1."ReconSumFC") OR MAX(T0."BalDueDeb") <> -SUM(T1."ReconSum") )
UNION ALL
SELECT MAX(T0."ShortName"), T0."TransId", MAX(T0."TransType"), MAX(T0."BaseRef"), MAX(T0."Ref1") AS "Ref1", MAX(T0."Ref2") AS "Ref2", MAX(T0."RefDate"), MAX(T0."DueDate"), MAX(T0."TaxDate"), MAX(T0."BalDueDeb"), MAX(T0."BalDueCred"), MAX(T0."BalFcDeb"), MAX(T0."BalFcCred"), MAX(T0."LineMemo"), MAX(T0."FCCurrency") FROM "JDT1" T0 INNER JOIN "OJDT" T1 ON T1."TransId" = T0."TransId" INNER JOIN "OCRD" T2 ON T2."CardCode" = T0."ShortName" WHERE 1 = 1 AND CASE WHEN branch = -1 THEN -1 ELSE T0."BPLId" END = branch AND T0."RefDate" BETWEEN fromDate AND toDate AND T0."DueDate" BETWEEN fromDateDue AND toDateDue AND T0."TaxDate" BETWEEN fromDateDoc AND toDateDoc AND T2."CardCode" = CardCode AND (T0."BalDueCred" <> T0."BalDueDeb" OR T0."BalFcCred" <> T0."BalFcDeb") AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT U0."TransId", U0."TransRowId" FROM "ITR1" U0 INNER JOIN "OITR" U1 ON U1."ReconNum" = U0."ReconNum" WHERE T0."TransId" = U0."TransId" AND T0."Line_ID" = U0."TransRowId" AND U1."ReconDate" > toDate GROUP BY U0."TransId", U0."TransRowId") GROUP BY T0."TransId", T0."Line_ID", T0."BPLName"; ELSE SELECT T0."ShortName", T0."Debit" AS "Debit", T0."Credit" AS "Credit", T0."TransId", T0."TransType", T0."RefDate", T0."DueDate", T0."TaxDate", T0."BaseRef", T0."Ref1", T0."Ref2", T0."LineMemo", T0."FCDebit" AS "FcDebit", T0."FCCredit" AS "FcCredit", T0."FCCurrency" FROM "JDT1" T0 WHERE T0."ShortName" = cardCode AND CASE WHEN branch = -1 THEN -1 ELSE T0."BPLId" END = branch AND T0."RefDate" BETWEEN fromDate AND toDate AND T0."DueDate" BETWEEN fromDateDue AND toDateDue AND T0."TaxDate" BETWEEN fromDateDoc AND toDateDoc; END IF; END;

WHERE TS0."CountryCod" = T0."BankCountr" AND TS0."BankCode" = T0."DflBnkCode") AS "BankName", (SELECT IFNULL(TS0."SwiftNum", '') FROM "ODSC" TS0 WHERE TS0."CountryCod" = T0."BankCountr" AND T0."DflBranch" AND TS0."Account" = T0."DflBnkAcct") AS "BankIban", (SELECT IFNULL(TS0."Street", '') FROM "DSC1" TS0 WHERE TS0."Country" = T0."BankCountr" AND TS0."BankCode" = T0."DflBnkCode" AND TS0."Branch" = T0."DflBranch" AND TS0."Account" = T0."DflBnkAcct") AS "BankStreet", (SELECT IFNULL(TS0."Block", '') FROM "DSC1" TS0 WHERE TS0."Country" = T0."BankCountr" AND TS0."BankCode" = T0."DflBnkCode" AND TS0."Branch" = T0."DflBranch" AND TS0."Account" = T0."DflBnkAcct") AS "BankBlock", (SELECT IFNULL(TS0."City", '') FROM "DSC1" TS0 WHERE TS0."Country" = T0."BankCountr" AND TS0."BankCode" = T0."DflBnkCode" AND TS0."Branch" = T0."DflBranch" AND TS0."Account" = T0."DflBnkAcct") AS "BankCity", (SELECT IFNULL(TS0."County", '') FROM "DSC1" TS0 WHERE TS0."Country" = T0."BankCountr" AND TS0."BankCode" = T0."DflBnkCode" AND TS0."Branch" = T0."DflBranch" AND TS0."Account" = T0."DflBnkAcct") AS "BankCounty", (SELECT IFNULL(TS0."State", '') FROM "DSC1" TS0 WHERE TS0."Country" = T0."BankCountr" AND TS0."BankCode" = T0."DflBnkCode" AND TS0."Branch" = T0."DflBranch" AND TS0."Account" = T0."DflBnkAcct") AS "BankState", (SELECT IFNULL(TS0."ZipCode", '') FROM "DSC1" TS0 WHERE TS0."Country" = T0."BankCountr" AND TS0."BankCode" = T0."DflBnkCode" AND TS0."Branch" = T0."DflBranch" AND TS0."Account" = T0."DflBnkAcct") AS "BankZipCode", IFNULL(T0."DflBnkAcct", '') AS "BankAccount", IFNULL(T0."DflBranch", '') AS "BankBranch", IFNULL(T0."HldCode", '') AS "HolidayCode", IFNULL(T0."MultiLang", '') AS "MultiLanguageSupport", IFNULL(T2."LogoFile", '') AS "Logo" FROM "OADM" T0 INNER JOIN "ADM1" T1 ON 1 = 1 INNER JOIN "OADP" T2 ON 1 = 1
